name: Palma de Mallorca Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest, 06L/24R, is 3,270 m long and 45 m wide

slots.v: a slot request counts as not authorised until confirmed coordination is received
slots.quote: The slot request shall be understood as not authorized until the reception of the confirmed coordination.

handling.v: a handling agent is mandatory for all general and business aviation; the AIP lists Aviapartner Palma de Mallorca FBO and Mallorcair as authorised FBOs
handling.quote: It is mandatory to contract handling agent for all operation to General and Business Aviation

max_aircraft.v: aircraft over 20 m long may park on the general aviation apron for at most 7 days
max_aircraft.quote: the maximum parking time on the general aviation apron for an aircraft over 20 m in length shall be 7 days

noise.v: at night (summer 2100-0500, winter 2200-0600) no training flights, no APU use and no reverse thrust above idle except for safety
noise.quote: The term night hours is defined as the time period comprised between: V: 2100-0500, I: 2200-0600.

ppr.v: the AIP states no general prior-permission rule for business aviation; only code letter F aircraft (A124, B748, A388) need the airport authority's prior permission to arrive or stay. From 1 April to 30 September general aviation slot requests must include both the arrival and the departure flight
ppr.quote: Neither the arrival nor the permanence of any code letter F aircraft will be authorized

notes: Source is the ENAIRE AIP amendment page for AD 2 LEPA/LESJ dated 03-SEP-26 (Amdt 2026/410); the current consolidated AD 2 page could not be opened. Night hours are given without UTC/LT marking (Spanish AIP normally uses UTC; if UTC both seasons equal 23:00-07:00 local) - not converted. The night rules restrict training, APU and reverse thrust; no ban on movements was found, but absence is not stated, so curfew is left missing. Footnote (1) on hours: foreign state/military aircraft need PPR 72 h ahead (not relevant to charter). GA ramp agents also listed: Aviapartner, General Aviation Service, Gestair, Jetland Executive Services, Mallorcair, Melendez, Sky Valet Spain. | 2026-10-30 run: read the current ENAIRE AD 2 LEPA/LESJ PDF (WEF 29-OCT-26). Curfew: AD 2.21 defines night hours (V: 2100-0500, I: 2200-0600, no UTC/LT marking) and bans training flights, engine run-ups and reverse thrust above idle at night, and RWY 24L take-offs; it neither bans night movements nor states that there is no night restriction, so curfew stays missing. PPR: the only PPR in AD 2.20 is for foreign state/military aircraft (72 h) and code letter F aircraft. Also in AD 2.20: from 1 May to 31 October use of the airport is restricted daily 0530-1930 for aircraft with cruising speed below 220 kt (except State, hospital and SAR aircraft) - time basis not stated; relevant to slow piston/turboprop types. Code F limited to A124, B748, A388 on RWY 06L/24R.
